headline: A 2019 executive order set up a federal commission to look at law enforcement and how the justice system is run.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order creates a commission focused on law enforcement and the administration of justice. Commissions like this usually study issues and make recommendations rather than set new rules directly. No summary was provided, so details about its members, duties, and deadlines are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Police and other law enforcement agencies
who_it_affects.how: The commission's work centers on law enforcement, though the title alone does not show any direct new requirements for them.

when_it_takes_effect: Executive orders generally take effect when signed, which was October 28, 2019.
